name: Zoios.
long_description:
Are you looking for a platform that can help you overcome people and culture challenges? 

We combine human expertise with advanced data analytics to help you achieve the results you dream about. Our platform helps organizations build a great culture, hire the right talent and lead their people.

There is no need to be guessing, and worrying all the time. Use Zoios to get real-time actions that will help you create an organization where employees thrive.
one_liner: Help start- and scale-ups excel at People, Culture and Performance.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I moved to Mumbai, India alone at age 15. When I came home I built a fashion webshop in Flash - went terribly but I naturally learned a ton. Went on to work in marketing as the SEO Lead for GroupM in The Nordics, before venturing out into startup life again with a supplement platform (raised some money and had a good run, but never a great business case). Went back to management consulting for a few years before I convinced Mikkel to join me at Zoios!
